name: evidenceos
description: EvidenceOS — agent-native medical research workspace monorepo.

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "make -C backend dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && make -C backend lint
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../webmcp && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && make -C backend test
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix webmcp run build
